episodes.synopsis: Tyson is caught up in the sport of Beyblading, but can he balance Beyblading and martial arts?
episodes.title: The Blade Raider

episodes.synopsis: When Tyson and Kai end up battling against each other, Tyson is easily defeated. Can he unlock a mythical bit beast to even the score?
episodes.title: Day of the Dragoon

episodes.synopsis: Can Kenny's friendship with Tyson continue when a new kid named Max seems to be stealing Tyson away?
episodes.title: Take It to the Max

episodes.synopsis: Max and Tyson arrive at the tournament and Tyson faces his first opponent.
episodes.title: The Qualifier Begins

episodes.synopsis: The first matchup in the semi-finals is Max vs. Kai. Can Max pull the upset off without a bitbeast giving him support?
episodes.title: Draciel of Approval

episodes.synopsis: The mysterious blader Ray and Tyson do battle in the second round. Can Tyson survive the mysterious Tiger Claw Attack?
episodes.title: Dragoon Storm

episodes.synopsis: The National Beyblade Championship Match is set -- with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson that the rookie sensation realizes he has forgotten his own birthday, but what will Kai have in store for him?
episodes.title: Thirteen Candles

episodes.synopsis: Tyson and his new team, the Bladebreakers, prepare for the World Championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers.
episodes.title: Bladin' In The Streets

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian World   Championships when they run into Ray's old gang, the White Tigers. Naturally, a Beyblade battle quickly ensues.
episodes.title: Showdown in Hong Kong

episodes.synopsis: The Bladebreakers discover that them and the White Tigers are in different divisons. To face them, they'll have to make it to the finals, but can the Unknown Tall Boys shock everyone and defeat the Bladebreakers ending all national title hopes?
episodes.title: Battle in the Sky

episodes.synopsis: Kevin decides to try and destroy Ray by stealing his data. What will happen if Kevin succeeds? Will the Bladebreakers have any chance of winning the Asian tournament, or will something worse happen?
episodes.title: Bye Bye Bit Beast

episodes.synopsis: With his bitbeast gone, Ray loses all confidence and decides to leave the Bladebreakers. Can Tyson convience him to come back, or will Mariah convience him that the White Tigers team is his real home?
episodes.title: Adios Bladebreakers

episodes.synopsis: With the Bladebreakers having impressed everyone, the White Tigers decide to get serious. Can they show everyone why they are the best?
episodes.title: Crouching Lion, Hidden Tiger

episodes.synopsis: A rockslide makes Tyson and Ray fall behind on their way to the semi-final matchup. Can they make it on time, or will a forfit keep the Bladebreakers from a showdown with the White Tigers?
episodes.title: The Race is On!

episodes.synopsis: The Asian finals begin between Max and Gary, but Gary's open-mindedness makes everyone think he can't win a thing. Will Gary's true wrath be unleashed to show why he battles instead of Kevin?
episodes.title: Going for the Gold

episodes.synopsis: Ray and Mariah get ready to go head to head, but can these two lovers put aside their feelings for the match. Maybe their bitbeasts will have something to say about it.
episodes.title: My Enemy, My Friend

episodes.synopsis: When Tyson and Lee's matchup turns out to be a draw, it's up to Ray to defeat his old team and keep Driger. How will Driger and Ray react to this news?
episodes.title: A Score to Settle

episodes.synopsis: With the Asian Tournament over, the Bladebreakers head home for a small break, but what will happen now that Tyson feels he has power?
episodes.title: A Star is Born

episodes.synopsis: Max insists on seeing his mom before the American tournament, but what will he do when he finds out she works for the opposing team?
episodes.title: Under the Microscope

episodes.synopsis: After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.
episodes.title: All Relative

episodes.synopsis: Can the Bladebreakers gain their confidence back after seeing all the fancy American equipment?
episodes.title: Practice Makes Perfect

episodes.synopsis: When Max participates in a charity Beyblade event, he must teach Emily what team work is all about. Can he succeed?
episodes.title: Blading with the Stars!

episodes.synopsis: The American tournament begins in Las Vegas. Will Kai decide to show the All Starz his true power?
episodes.title: Showdown in Vegas

episodes.synopsis: The Blade Breakers decide to study the All Starz moves so they can become stronger. Will they succeed?
episodes.title: Viva Las Vegas

episodes.synopsis: When Tyson gets a stomachache before the semi-finals, Kai must step up and take his place. Can the Bladebreakers keep their momentum going in the mysterious New Jersey Turnpike?
episodes.title: My Way or the Highway

episodes.synopsis: Tyson's health is restored before the finals, so he gets ready to battle again. Can Max help them realize he can defeat his mom's team, or will Kai get the final spot?
episodes.title: Catch a Shooting All-Star

episodes.synopsis: The finals continue. Can the Blade Breakers muster the strength to win, or will the All Starz become the new American Champions?
episodes.title: The Battle of America

episodes.synopsis: It's Max versus Michael for the American team championship. Which team will end up being victorious?
episodes.title: Bottom of the Ninth

episodes.synopsis: Kenny ponders how the Bladebreakers got together, and he wonders what the next touranment will bring.
episodes.title: Play It Again, Dizzi!

episodes.synopsis: When the Bladebreakers run into Robert on a ship to Russia, they realize just how much their bitbeasts need to develop. Can they learn how to gain the strength needed?
episodes.title: Cruising for a Bruising

episodes.synopsis: When the Bladebreakers arrive in London, a mysterious tape about evil bitbeasts is waiting for Tyson. Can they interpret what Tyson's father is trying to tell them before they encounter an evil bitbeast, or is it already to late?
episodes.title: London Calling

episodes.synopsis: The Dark Bladers try once again to steal the Bladebreakers bitbeasts and turn them evil in a subway tunnel. Will they succeed?
episodes.title: Darkness at the End of the Tunnel

episodes.synopsis: The Blade Breakers arrive in Paris, but the Dark Bladers follow them there. Can the Blade Breakers handle one more battle with the Dark Bladers, or will additional and unexpected help come to save them?
episodes.title: Last Tangle in Paris

episodes.synopsis: Tyson determines to battle the blader named Oliver, but does he have any chance at victory?
episodes.title: Art Attack

episodes.synopsis: The Blade Breakers arrive in Rome to battle against their next opponent, Enrique. Can Tyson finally successfully defeat one of Europe's top bladers, or will he learn that he has a lot of skills to develop?
episodes.title: When in Rome... Beyblade

episodes.synopsis: Tyson determines that he must defeat Enrique if his reputation as a top Beyblader is to be restored, but when Oliver arrives it becomes 2 of Europe's top bladers against Tyson's ego. Can he figure out a way to show that bitbeasts should be used for more than just power?
episodes.title: Deja Vu All Over Again

episodes.synopsis: Enrique and Oliver take the Blade Breakers to Robert's mansion, but can Tyson get his rematch against Robert, or will this Johnny character interfer?
episodes.title: A Knight to Remember

episodes.synopsis: The Blade Breakers decide to challenge Robert, Johnny, Enrique, and Oliver to a team battle. They accept, but can ""The Majestics"" work together as a team when they've been individual fighters their entire life?
episodes.title: Olympia Challenge

episodes.synopsis: It's Kai versus Johnny and Tyson versus Robert for the right to go to the World Championships in Russia. Who will win the bout?
episodes.title: A Majestic Battle... A Majestic Victory?

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious man named Boris invites the Bladebreakers to his physilities for a practice battle. Should they trust him, and if they do, then can they win the battle?
episodes.title: Hot Battle in a Cold Town

episodes.synopsis: Kai investigates Boris' Abbey since he feels some sort of draw to it. What will he find? Also, Max meets up with the All Starz and Ray meets up with the White Tigers. Why have they come to Russia?
episodes.title: Out of the Past

episodes.synopsis: Kai must choose whether he wants the power of Dark Dranzer or the friendship of the Blade Breakers. Which will he decide?
episodes.title: Drawn to the Darkness

episodes.synopsis: While the Bladebreakers try and find out what Kai's doing, the All Starz get ready to scrimmage the Demolition Boys, but when Kai shows up on the Demolition Boys and challenges all 4 All Starz at once, you know fire works will erupt. What will he do?
episodes.title: Live and Let Kai!

episodes.synopsis: The White Tigers determine to get revenge on Kai for the All Starz, but will they need to when Tyson and the Bladebreakers decide to try and talk some sense into Kai?
episodes.title: Losing Kai

episodes.synopsis: Kai decides he wants all of the bitbeast, so he challenges the Bladebreakers to a match. Will they stand a chance without Max, who's with his mom at the airport?
episodes.title: Breaking the Ice

episodes.synopsis: Kai and Tyson's father appear to let everyone know what Biovalt is really up to. Can the Bladebreakers find a way to stop them?
episodes.title: First Strike

episodes.synopsis: The Majestics show up in Russia with a challenge for the Bladebreakers, defeat them in a match, or lose their bitbeasts. Why have they come to Russia, and why do they want the Bladebreakes bitbeasts?
episodes.title: A Lesson for Tyson

episodes.synopsis: Kai is given a tempting offer from his grandfather Voltaire, use dark Dranzer, or risk losing Dranzer forever. Will he give in?
episodes.title: Victory in Defeat

episodes.synopsis: With Kai losing in the first round, Ray must find some way to even up the score. Can he find the strength to do so, and if he does, will he risk losing Drigger forever?
episodes.title: A Wicked Wind Blows

episodes.synopsis: When Tala gets cyber implants and Tyson gets new blading equipment, you know their match strategy's are bound to change, but just how will the changes affect the championship?
episodes.title: New and Cyber-Improved...

episodes.synopsis: A grave meeting is held between the Majestics, Kevin of the White Tigers, and the Dark Bladers in case Tyson should lose the match. Can Tyson survive in this other dimension, or will the Demolition Boys become World Champions and rulers?
episodes.title: Final Showdown
